name: OpenScience
description: Runs a research agent for scientists that reviews literature, writes and runs analysis code, and reproduces experiments, from a desktop app, browser workspace, or CLI.

skills.name: Literature Review
skills.description: Searches scientific sources, compares findings, and saves cited evidence, with connectors to databases such as PubMed, arXiv, and UniProt.

skills.name: Data Analysis
skills.description: Inspects input data, writes and runs analysis code in shell, Python, or R kernels, and produces figures and reports in the project folder.

skills.name: Experiment Reproduction
skills.description: Agrees on a claim, its prerequisites, and a budget with you, then reruns the experiment and compares the measured results to the claim.

skills.name: Remote Compute
skills.description: Sends long or GPU-bound jobs to Modal, SSH hosts, or Slurm and PBS clusters, with each dispatch approved by you before it runs.

skills.name: Headless Runs
skills.description: Runs a single research turn from a script or pipeline with openscience run, and continues the same session with the --continue flag.
